pages.text: A cargo boat arrived in the canal. The neighbors' things were loaded aboard, one by one.
Today that family was moving far away. Pongi stood by their door.
"I want to give them something." Pongi rubbed the tips of her feet together.
Dad dragged something out of the shed. It was a very big wooden chair.
"They'll like this, won't they?" Dad pushed the chair onto the boat.
The boat tilted to one side. Water rose into the boat.
Grandpa Goose waved his hand. "We can't load any more."
Pongi came out with a sheet of paper. It had a picture of the canal, the bridge, and the house.
The child next door waved from the bow of the boat. Beside the child lay the picture.
